item.title: Lucky
item.description:
Platform: Apple TV+
First Air Date: 2026-07-14

When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.

item.title: Our Sticky Love
item.description:
Platform: Netflix
First Air Date: 2026-08-07

An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

item.title: Sterling Point
item.description:
Platform: Prime Video
First Air Date: 2026-08-05

After discovering she's inherited a remote island in Canada from the estranged grandfather she was never allowed to meet, 17-year-old Annie Jacobson decides to investigate, pulling her into a world of buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and the complicated family history she was never meant to find.

item.title: Elite Force

After an unprecedented attack on his unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.
